lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately three horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the circular blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the upper edge and shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, high-reflectance elongated objects, likely commensal fish, positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin.
